Howdy team! I have formalized the dev workflow I follow for < and < into plugins. At a high level this is what the plugin is doing: 1. hook on initial submit to load all skills and agents metadata into memory 2. hook on initial submit to checkout master/main, pull master, checkout a new branch using JIRA ticket number 3. pull ticket context and begin working on ticket dedicating work to sub-agents (includes dev work agents and testing agents) a. this is the only non-deterministic step b. moving forward, this is where i am spending the most time. Making sure my subagent stays current is a challenge 4. hook to run linting and build commands, failures trigger agent to rework solution 5. hook to commit and push the initial PR
